bibl.title: A Greek Acclamation in Praise of an illustris from Seventh-Century Egypt (P.Berol.inv. 5603 Reconsidered).
bibl.seg: Lajos Berkes & Ágnes T. Mihálykó, A Greek Acclamation in Praise of an illustris from Seventh-Century Egypt (P.Berol.inv. 5603 Reconsidered).
bibl.note: P. Berol. Inv. 5603 (= van Haelst 871; LDAB 6224). The papyrus can be shown to offer not a prayer as has been thought but a metrical acclamation, probably in honor of a pagarch of the Arsinoite nome.
